race.description: Hunter Pacific - Matchmaster - Omni Mdn Plate
race.comment: MADE IN ITALY (7) brings the strongest profile, with eight placings from nine starts and four placings from five runs around 1600m. Her Warwick Farm fifth behind True Tone reads well for this after she was blocked early and still finished within just over two lengths, and her Newcastle second prior showed she is holding form. No excuses today. VICTORIOUS RULER (12) shapes as the main danger after missing by a long neck at Hawkesbury on soft ground over this trip. On the up and has the speed to get across from the awkward gate. RATIFY (3) comes through a solid Rosehill mid-week third after early interference and now finds easier company, though his two unplaced 1600m attempts leave a small question. Strengthened over the break and can go on with it this campaign. MISS BLACK BETTY (10) thrown in the deep end with a battling ninth over 1400m in the G3 Reginald Allen Quality at Randwick. Trip suits and can take a hand in the finish.
